title: banksia microcephala
intro: Banksia microcephala, commonly known as the hairy banksia, is a species of shrub in the family Proteaceae. It is native to Western Australia and is prized for its unique, woolly leaves and compact growth habit. The health benefits of Banksia microcephala include its potential use as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
